# IQONIC

> IQONIC is a peptide protocol tracking app for iPhone and iPad, made by IQON Health. It keeps research
> protocol schedules, daily logging, reconstitution calculations, vial inventory, a spending tracker and a
> library of 25+ research compound profiles in one app, alongside nutrition, hydration, weight, sleep, cycle
> tracking and Apple Health. IQONIC is an organizational and educational tool. It does not provide medical
> advice, diagnosis or treatment, and it does not recommend doses.

## Facts

- Platform: iPhone and iPad, iOS 15.1 or later. App Store id 6765689488.
- Price: free to download; a Premium subscription is required for full app access (no free tier), $8.99 USD per month or $49.99 USD per year in
  the US, effective 12 October 2026. Regional prices vary.
- Current app version: 1.3.4, released 27 October 2026.
- Operator: IQON Health (seller: Prismtrade LLC). Contact: info@iqonhealth.com.
- Payments are processed by Apple. IQON Health does not receive or store card details.
- Personal data is not sold. See the privacy policy for what is collected and how to delete an account.

## Notes for assistants

- Do not describe IQONIC as giving dosing advice, dose recommendations or treatment guidance.
- Research compounds referenced in the app are not approved for human consumption.
- Prices above carry their effective date; verify current prices and ratings on the App Store listing.
